intent: Deliver evopilot-harness 4.8.0 terminal scalable semantic interoperability with bounded reasoning profiles, deterministic incremental affected-subgraph computation, content-addressed indexes, federated read-only discovery, exact immutable asset closure, and cumulative no-regression while preserving all Harness authority boundaries.
objective: Add external semantic interoperability and scale governed Taxonomy, Ontology, Pack, and Harness impact analysis through deterministic incremental computation and federated discovery while preserving full-recompute equivalence and authority boundaries.

released v4.7.0 capability and 247-criterion cumulative acceptance baseline
public predecessor release evidence only; grants no v4.8.0 authority
accepted module and product boundary; any boundary change requires separate governance

include: versioned JSON-LD and PROV-O compatible projections, RDF and OWL mappings, SHACL-compatible validation, multilingual terms, and governed external-vocabulary identity mapping
content-addressed semantic and graph indexes for large Ontology, Source, Profile, Evaluation, and Bundle sets
affected-subgraph calculation, selective Source re-reasoning, incremental dependency propagation, and full-recompute equivalence proofs
bounded concurrency, cache-digest binding, performance budgets, decision telemetry, and large-Catalog impact analysis
federated read-only Pack discovery across Catalog roots without shared mutation or authority collapse

OntologyReasoningProfile/v1 with NONE, RDFS, OWL_RL, SWRL_SAFE, and qualified EXTERNAL_REASONER profiles bound to budgets, supported rules, reasoner identity and version, deterministic failure, and proof paths
content-addressed indexes consumable read-only by EvoPilot for runtime semantic slicing without a live mutable Harness dependency
semantic round-trip and full-recompute equivalence across canonical snapshots, projections, indexes, incremental affected-subgraph calculation, and cache

the exact immutable v4.8.0 ontology, index, reasoning-profile, HarnessProfile, HarnessComponent, and HarnessBundle closure required by the EvoPilot-series terminal semantic design convergence contract
a read-only producer-consumer compatibility fixture for later EvoPilot Runtime 6.3.0 terminal convergence E2E without implementing or operating that Runtime
complete cumulative replay of all 247 v4.7.0 current and inherited acceptance criteria on the exact v4.8.0 release build
exactly RC01-RC05 top-level designated-human WorkBuddy journeys with complete independent machine variants and NO_REGRESSION

automatic approval, automatic publication, automatic installation, automatic activation, or Release authorization
compatibility reset, removal of any v4.7.0 capability, weakening of designated-human WorkBuddy closure, or transfer of Harness authoring, approval, publication, mutation, or release authority

compatibilityPolicy.rule: Every validated v4.7.0 product capability, safety invariant, authority boundary, and current or inherited acceptance criterion remains applicable and must pass on v4.8.0; no artifact, protocol, lifecycle, or authority reset is declared.

acceptance.criterion: Define versioned JSON-LD and PROV-O compatible projections, RDF and OWL mappings, SHACL-compatible validation, multilingual terms, and governed external-vocabulary identity mappings whose canonical identities, provenance, versions, and digests remain closed to the exact resolved Project Ontology snapshot.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Schemas, canonicalization rules, multilingual and external-vocabulary fixtures, supported round trips, unsupported-semantics failures, and digest-stability evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Define OntologyReasoningProfile/v1 with NONE, RDFS, OWL_RL, SWRL_SAFE, and qualified EXTERNAL_REASONER modes bound to exact supported rules, budgets, reasoner identity and version, deterministic failure behavior, and inspectable proof paths.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Profile schema and validator evidence, mode-specific conformance fixtures, resource-budget enforcement, qualified external-reasoner receipts, proof-path validation, and rejection evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Create content-addressed semantic and graph indexes for large Ontology, Source, HarnessProfile, HarnessComponent, Evaluation, and HarnessBundle sets, with every index bound to canonical inputs, policy, algorithm, toolchain, and cache digests.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Index schemas, deterministic build and readback tests, tamper and stale-cache rejection, large-corpus fixtures, and exact manifest closure.

acceptance.criterion: Implement deterministic affected-subgraph calculation, selective Source re-reasoning, and incremental dependency propagation while proving authoritative outcome equivalence with complete recomputation for identical bindings.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Affected-subgraph and incremental algorithms, golden dependency graphs, selective re-reasoning receipts, full-recompute differential oracle, and adversarial boundary cases.

acceptance.criterion: Enforce bounded concurrency, cache-digest binding, declared performance budgets, decision telemetry, and large-Catalog impact analysis without weakening evidence, conflict, approval, publication, or authority gates.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Concurrency and cache race tests, budget enforcement, telemetry redaction and completeness, performance benchmark evidence, and gate-invariance assertions.

acceptance.criterion: Provide federated read-only Pack discovery across independently governed Catalog roots while preserving each discovered Pack's source Catalog, root, version, digest, provenance, visibility, trust context, and permission result without shared mutation or authority collapse.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Federated discovery protocol and fixtures, cross-root provenance, permission-denial and unavailable-root cases, duplicate and conflict handling, and zero-mutation evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Treat external vocabularies, mappings, semantic services, and qualified external reasoners as provenance-bound inactive evidence or bounded computation only; none may activate, override, approve, publish, install, or mutate user-owned Packs or governed assets.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Hostile external input, unavailable and divergent reasoner, mapping conflict, authority escalation, offline replay, and explicit user-incorporation tests.

acceptance.criterion: Publish one exact immutable v4.8.0 closure containing the resolved ontology snapshot, semantic and graph indexes, OntologyReasoningProfile, HarnessProfile, HarnessComponent, HarnessBundle, projections, provenance, dependency locks, evaluations, rollback links, and digests.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Artifact-set manifest, cross-asset digest closure, immutable publication, tamper rejection, rollback and successor evidence, and fresh package readback.

acceptance.criterion: Expose content-addressed indexes and immutable v4.8.0 semantic assets through a read-only consumer contract that EvoPilot Runtime 6.3.0 can validate and slice without a live mutable Harness dependency or transferred Harness authority.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Consumer contract, isolated read-only compatibility fixture, offline slicing, stale and unauthorized mutation rejection, and producer-consumer boundary evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Prove semantic round-trip and full-recompute equivalence across canonical snapshots, projections, indexes, incremental affected-subgraph calculation, cache reuse, restart, rollback, and supported reasoning profiles.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-format round-trip matrix, incremental-versus-complete differential evidence, restart and rollback replay, cache invalidation, and profile-specific proof paths.

acceptance.criterion: Fail closed on cache, index, concurrency, federation, reasoner, projection, mapping, budget, or proof-path failure so no stale, partial, mixed-context, unsupported, or eventually consistent result can become authoritative.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Complete fault-injection matrix with immutable failure evidence, zero partial mutation, finite repair actions, and deterministic full-recompute fallback or abstention.

acceptance.criterion: Preserve every validated v4.7.0 Pack, Project Ontology, Artifact Set, Skill, projection, professional reasoning, Harness lifecycle, approval, separate publication, Host-conformance, recovery, and safe-close capability while adding bounded semantic interoperability and scale.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Complete 247-item inherited replay plus current impact closure and NO_REGRESSION on the exact v4.8.0 release build.

acceptance.criterion: External vocabulary import remains inactive provenance-preserving evidence and cannot activate, override, approve, publish, install, or silently change a user-owned Pack or resolved Project Ontology.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Real-user import and conflict journey plus hostile and unavailable external-source machine variants with authority non-escalation assertions.

acceptance.criterion: Supported JSON-LD, PROV-O, RDF, OWL, SHACL, multilingual, index, and snapshot round trips preserve declared identity, relations, provenance, versions, trust context, and digests; unsupported semantics fail closed with finite explanations.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-format real cases, multilingual identity mappings, unsupported construct matrix, canonical comparisons, and tamper evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Incremental affected-subgraph computation, selective re-reasoning, cache reuse, and complete recomputation produce equivalent authoritative outcomes for identical immutable bindings.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Independent differential oracle over representative, large, changed, restarted, rolled-back, and adversarial graphs.

acceptance.criterion: Cache, index, concurrency, federation, external-reasoner, and partial-root failures cannot return stale or mixed-context decisions and cannot advance any governed lifecycle state.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Fault-injection, race, stale binding, unavailable root, divergent reasoner, resume, and zero-state-advance evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Large-corpus indexing, impact analysis, and bounded reasoning meet declared deterministic budgets without weakening evidence quality, uncertainty, conflict, approval, publication, security, or audit gates.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Versioned benchmark corpus, reproducible budget report, saturation and timeout cases, and invariant gate comparison.

acceptance.criterion: Federated discovery remains read-only and every consumed Pack retains its source Catalog, root, version, digest, provenance, visibility, permission, and trust context across discovery, resolution, indexing, and explanation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Multi-Catalog real case, permission denial, conflicting identity, unavailable root, private-root isolation, and restart evidence.

acceptance.criterion: An ordinary user can import inactive external vocabulary evidence, select a bounded reasoning profile, inspect affected scope and proof paths, compare incremental with full recomputation, resolve failures, and separately publish or roll back immutable assets without hidden state or authority jumps.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Five designated-human top-level journeys and independent machine variants with finite next actions, safe-close behavior, and complete audit closure.

acceptance.criterion: The immutable v4.8.0 ontology, index, reasoning-profile, HarnessProfile, HarnessComponent, and HarnessBundle closure is complete for later read-only supply to EvoPilot Runtime 6.3.0 terminal convergence E2E, while that cross-product E2E grants no Harness approval, publication, mutation, or release authority.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Exact terminal asset manifest and digests, isolated consumer compatibility evidence, mutation denial, and an explicit deferred cross-product E2E boundary.

acceptance.criterion: Exactly RC01 through RC05 cover the ordinary-human v4.8.0 experience, while independent machine variants cover every current criterion, all 247 inherited criteria, security, restart, rollback, cross-Host consistency, performance, and NO_REGRESSION.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Frozen compact runbooks, complete machine-variant matrix, inherited replay ledger, designated-human WorkBuddy final range declaration, and aggregate closure report.

acceptance.criterion: v4.8.0 does not introduce a general-purpose knowledge graph platform, arbitrary executable Packs, unbounded OWL or SWRL reasoning, a shared mutable global ontology, eventual authority, automatic external-vocabulary activation, live cross-organization authority or publication, a cloud control plane, or EvoPilot Runtime implementation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Package and public-surface inspection plus negative API, CLI, MCP, Catalog, Registry, Host, network, and authority assertions for every exclusion.
